text:
sophia: Hey team — PR #3421 (migration guide + CLI + SDK snippets) needs reviewer handoffs. Trying to target Friday 18:00 PT merge. Who can take which part? Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3421

docs-bot: Docs preview started for PR #3421 — preview URL: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/pr/3421 :hourglass:

deploy-bot: linkcheck failed on /docs/guides/migrate-v2-to-v3.md: missing external link https://old.example.com/migrate. Check failing job: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/3421/12

ben: I can take SDK snippets. Will look at the python/js examples tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

maria: I'll take migration guide. Can fix the broken link and run linkcheck locally. FYI I'm in Europe so can finish by 10:00 PT.

alex: Can pick up CLI reference, but I'm heads-down today. If no one else volunteers, I can review later tonight around 21:00 PT.

sam: If you want faster merge, we can split approvals: docs + eng signoff. Are we ok with merging once preview passes? We'd need at least one docs reviewer + one engineer signoff.

sophia: yes that's the plan. Need at least one docs reviewer and one eng-review for CLI examples. Ben + Maria covers that. Alex if you can't, can someone from platform team do the eng signoff? @jamal

jamal: I can do the eng signoff for CLI tonight. Will re-run the snippet tests. Ping me when preview passes.

ben: Quick heads up — some SDK snippets use `Client()` ctor that changed in v3. I'll add a note and run `pip install -e .` to test.

ben: code:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key='@token')
```

maria: Found the old link — replacing with https://redwood.ai/migrate-v2-to-v3 and adding redirect note. I'll push a small commit.

docs-bot: Preview updated: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/pr/3421 — linkcheck passed :white_check_mark:

sophia: Awesome. Who can merge? I'd prefer to wait until 18:00 PT so we can monitor flakiness in prod.

sam: I can merge at 18:00 PT and watch logs. Please tag me with `@sam merge-ready` when green.

ben: `@sam merge-ready` — SDK examples fixed and tested. Ready.

maria: migration link fixed and CI green. Ready.

alex: CLI review done earlier than expected. Good to go. :rocket:

sophia: Great — final checklist: preview URL, linkcheck green, one docs reviewer, one eng signoff, no failing lint. I'll post in #release-war-room 10 mins before merge. Thanks! :shipit:
